snippet.title: Quantic River | "Zenmetsu" Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Quantic River – Official Game Channel

Alpha gameplay footage of Quantic River, fast-paced 2.5D cyberpunk action game. Captured in-engine with Unreal Engine 5.

Music composed by Brett Janzen
Quantic River developed by FluidFury Interactive
